General Information
New in the Original Packaging ( Unless Bulk Packed)
Quality Aftermarket Part

What is This Part?
This is the Fuel Filler PREMIUM Locking Gas Cap
Standard 2 Tab Design
Heavy Duty “ALL METAL” – Premium Gas Cap
Comes with 2 Keys!
“Full Size” Keys – no fumbling around with miniature keys
Spring Loaded Key Hole Cover Keeps the water out & Extends the life of the cap
Self Venting – No worrying about a vapor lock due to pressure build-up
Built in Twist/Torque Limiter to prevent over tightening that could restrict air flow into the tank
Works on both Carburated and Fuel Injected Gas Tanks
***** See Attached Sheet for Size Specifications *****
THIS IS THE MOST RUGGED GAS CAP MADE!

Qty 1 – Locking Gas Cap “2 Tab/All Metal/Heavy Duty
